membershipEvidence.notes: Complete medium-fi mine surface reconstruction from86independent assets and87existing placements: all79original central-site building ways, including outdoor process bodies, plus four shaft-surface structures and three stack assets at four stack locations. The two historical anode stacks reuse one geometry at their two original1997table coordinates. The1997table columns explicitly describe existing pre-expansion stacks; proposed post-expansion heights were excluded. The later2024lit obstacle is independently positioned from primary aeronautical data. Exact current main/acid process-stack correspondence is unverified; it does not prevent the requested best-effort exterior reconstruction. Shapes, equipment identities, surveyed grade ties and mixed-date continuity retain their existing explicit estimates. No invented open pit, town-building substitute, generic whole-mine box or engineering equipment census. Cleared Qualla NASA imagery and all existing member reference selections remain unchanged.
